summary:
VIDAR is an AI-powered research intelligence platform designed to advance the study of microgravity combustion and space fire safety. It brings together NASA research documents, scientific literature, combustion experiment data and AI-assisted analysis. The platform enables users to explore research, examine and compare experiments, retrieve scientific information through an AI-powered copilot, identify knowledge gaps, analyze research priorities and investigate potential risks and mission scenarios. VIDAR aims to make complex scientific research more accessible and structured, supporting future research into safer long-duration space exploration.

Developed by Team Codey Blinders.
